mapper.select: select current_evaluation_year as "currentEvaluationYear", default_search_year as "defaultSearchYear", updated_by as "updatedBy", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason" from evaluation_year_settings where id = 1

select target_year as "targetYear", copy_requested_yn as "copyRequestedYn", reset_requested_yn as "resetRequestedYn", updated_by as "updatedBy", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason" from evaluation_year_preparations order by target_year desc
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_year_settings (id, current_evaluation_year, default_search_year, updated_by, change_reason) values (1, #{currentEvaluationYear}, #{defaultSearchYear}, #{updatedBy}, #{changeReason}) on conflict (id) do update set current_evaluation_year = EXCLUDED.current_evaluation_year, default_search_year = EXCLUDED.default_search_year, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason

insert into evaluation_year_preparations (target_year, copy_requested_yn, reset_requested_yn, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{targetYear}, #{copyRequestedYn}, #{resetRequestedYn}, #{updatedBy}, #{changeReason}) on conflict (target_year) do update set copy_requested_yn = EXCLUDED.copy_requested_yn, reset_requested_yn = EXCLUDED.reset_requested_yn, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason
